with recursive days as ( select current_date as forecastDate, 1 as dayNo union all select date_add(forecastDate, interval 1 day), dayNo + 1 from days where dayNo < #{days} ), models as ( select coalesce(p.model_id, p.product_id) as modelId, coalesce(nullif(p.model_name, ''), p.product_name) as itemName, max(p.brand) as brand, sum(i.total_quantity) as totalQuantity, sum(i.available_quantity) as currentAvailable, sum(case when coalesce(i.calculation_mode, 1) = 1 then i.available_quantity else 0 end) as fixedAvailable, sum(case when coalesce(i.calculation_mode, 1) = 1 then coalesce(i.stock_protection_qty, 0) else 0 end) as fixedProtection, sum(case when coalesce(i.calculation_mode, 1) = 2 then floor(i.total_quantity * coalesce(i.calculation_percent, 0) / 100) else 0 end) as percentCapacity, sum(case when coalesce(i.calculation_mode, 1) = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as fixedPolicyCount, sum(case when coalesce(i.calculation_mode, 1) = 2 then 1 else 0 end) as percentPolicyCount from ry_business.ry_rental_merchant_inventory i inner join ry_business.ry_rental_product p on p.product_id = i.product_id and p.tenant_id = i.tenant_id and p.member_id = i.member_id and p.is_delete = 0 where i.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and i.member_id = #{memberId} and i.is_delete = 0 and i.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} and p.brand = #{brand} and p.model_id = #{modelId} group by coalesce(p.model_id, p.product_id), coalesce(nullif(p.model_name, ''), p.product_name) ), demand as ( select d.forecastDate, coalesce(op.model_id, op.product_id) as modelId, sum(oi.quantity) as quantity from days d inner join ry_business.ry_rental_order o on d.forecastDate between o.lease_start_date and o.lease_end_date and o.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and o.member_id = #{memberId} and o.is_delete = 0 and o.order_status not in #{status} inner join ry_business.ry_rental_order_item oi on oi.order_id = o.order_id and oi.tenant_id = o.tenant_id and oi.member_id = o.member_id and oi.is_delete = 0 inner join ry_business.ry_rental_product op on op.product_id = oi.product_id and op.tenant_id = oi.tenant_id and op.member_id = oi.member_id and op.is_delete = 0 group by d.forecastDate, coalesce(op.model_id, op.product_id) ) , projected as ( select d.forecastDate, m.modelId, m.itemName, m.brand, m.totalQuantity, m.fixedAvailable, m.fixedProtection, m.percentCapacity, m.fixedPolicyCount, m.percentPolicyCount, greatest(m.currentAvailable - coalesce(dm.quantity, 0), 0) as availableQuantity from days d cross join models m left join demand dm on dm.forecastDate = d.forecastDate and dm.modelId = m.modelId ) select 'model' as overviewType, forecastDate, modelId, itemName, brand, totalQuantity, availableQuantity, case when percentPolicyCount = 0 then greatest(availableQuantity - fixedProtection, 0) when fixedPolicyCount = 0 then least(availableQuantity, percentCapacity) else least(availableQuantity, greatest(fixedAvailable - fixedProtection, 0) + percentCapacity) end as orderableQuantity from projected order by forecastDate, itemName

with recursive days as ( select current_date as forecastDate, 1 as dayNo union all select date_add(forecastDate, interval 1 day), dayNo + 1 from days where dayNo < #{days} ), package_items as ( select p.package_id as packageId, p.package_name as itemName, p.package_code as itemCode, coalesce(pi.product_id, pi.accessory_item_product_id) as componentProductId, pi.quantity from ry_business.ry_rental_merchant_package p inner join ry_business.ry_rental_merchant_package_version v on v.package_id = p.package_id and v.version_status = 1 and v.is_delete = 0 inner join ry_business.ry_rental_merchant_package_item pi on pi.package_version_id = v.package_version_id and pi.required_flag = 1 and pi.is_delete = 0 where p.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and p.member_id = #{memberId} and p.status = 0 and p.is_delete = 0 ), package_demand as ( select d.forecastDate, oi.package_id as packageId, sum(oi.quantity) as quantity from days d inner join ry_business.ry_rental_order o on d.forecastDate between o.lease_start_date and o.lease_end_date and o.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and o.member_id = #{memberId} and o.is_delete = 0 and o.order_status not in #{status} inner join ry_business.ry_rental_order_item oi on oi.order_id = o.order_id and oi.tenant_id = o.tenant_id and oi.member_id = o.member_id and oi.is_delete = 0 and oi.package_id is not null group by d.forecastDate, oi.package_id ), component_base as ( select d.forecastDate, pi.packageId, pi.itemName, pi.itemCode, pi.quantity, coalesce(sum(inv.total_quantity), 0) as totalQuantity, coalesce(sum(inv.available_quantity), 0) as currentAvailable, coalesce(sum(case when inv.inventory_id is not null and coalesce(inv.calculation_mode, 1) = 1 then inv.available_quantity else 0 end), 0) as fixedAvailable, coalesce(sum(case when inv.inventory_id is not null and coalesce(inv.calculation_mode, 1) = 1 then coalesce(inv.stock_protection_qty, 0) else 0 end), 0) as fixedProtection, coalesce(sum(case when inv.inventory_id is not null and coalesce(inv.calculation_mode, 1) = 2 then floor(inv.total_quantity * coalesce(inv.calculation_percent, 0) / 100) else 0 end), 0) as percentCapacity, coalesce(sum(case when inv.inventory_id is not null and coalesce(inv.calculation_mode, 1) = 1 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as fixedPolicyCount, coalesce(sum(case when inv.inventory_id is not null and coalesce(inv.calculation_mode, 1) = 2 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as percentPolicyCount, coalesce(max(pd.quantity), 0) as packageDemand from days d cross join package_items pi left join ry_business.ry_rental_merchant_inventory inv on inv.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and inv.member_id = #{memberId} and inv.product_id = pi.componentProductId and inv.is_delete = 0 and inv.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} left join package_demand pd on pd.forecastDate = d.forecastDate and pd.packageId = pi.packageId group by d.forecastDate, pi.packageId, pi.itemName, pi.itemCode, pi.quantity ), component_projection as ( select forecastDate, packageId, itemName, itemCode, floor(totalQuantity / nullif(quantity, 0)) as totalQuantity, greatest(currentAvailable - packageDemand * quantity, 0) as availableQuantity, case when percentPolicyCount = 0 then greatest(currentAvailable - packageDemand * quantity - fixedProtection, 0) when fixedPolicyCount = 0 then least(greatest(currentAvailable - packageDemand * quantity, 0), percentCapacity) else least(greatest(currentAvailable - packageDemand * quantity, 0), greatest(fixedAvailable - fixedProtection, 0) + percentCapacity) end as orderableQuantity from component_base ), packages as ( select forecastDate, packageId, max(itemName) as itemName, max(itemCode) as itemCode, min(totalQuantity) as totalQuantity, min(availableQuantity) as availableQuantity, min(orderableQuantity) as orderableQuantity from component_projection group by forecastDate, packageId ) select 'package' as overviewType, forecastDate, packageId, itemName, itemCode, totalQuantity, availableQuantity, orderableQuantity from packages order by forecastDate, itemName
